objective: Finish canonical Distributor Status ↔ Payment Collections integration without duplicating financial authority.

acceptance.description: Migration 045 is additive, has nullable receivables.distributor_id FK ON DELETE RESTRICT, canonical indexes, and zero historical financial row mutation.
Existing Receivables command RPC signature is preserved; optional canonical distributor_id is validated and persisted on create while legacy no-UUID payload remains compatible.
Existing import_receivables_v1 signature is preserved; canonical distributor_id is validated/staged/hashed/persisted; legacy no-UUID path remains compatible.

Distributor-first bounded collection read model derives NOT_BILLED, COLLECTION_SETUP_REQUIRED, UNPAID, PARTIALLY_PAID, PAID and DISPUTED from canonical authorities with filter-before-pagination and page max 50.
Payment Collections exposes Distributor Collections, Total Collected and Collection Setup Required without removing invoice-level Receivables.
Distributor Status shows read-only Payment/Received/Outstanding and reuses Receivables create/payment actions; multiple outstanding receivables require exact selection.
Manual create and spreadsheet import resolve canonical Distributor identity; no fuzzy matching; PR53 Auth employee resolver remains unchanged.
Focused DB/unit/E2E/typecheck/build verification passes on exact final head with production-shaped disposable fixtures only.
Owner precheck still proves zero production financial rows before applying migration 045; owner SQL is reviewed and manually applied; production certification is read-only/natural.
